sourceFull: Data: Deccan Herald (Apr 2025); Flyvbjerg & Gardner, How Big Things Get Done

parts: A metro line in Bengaluru was promised for twenty twenty.
It's twenty twenty-six, and it still isn't carrying passengers.
Meanwhile, barricades, dust and diversions become part of daily life, for years.
Big projects don't stall because of one thing.
It's land, permits, contractors, utilities, funding and trains, each waiting on the other.
Studies of thousands of big projects worldwide find that more than nine in ten run over budget, over time, or both.
What if every team could see the same plan, in real time?
One live schedule that every contractor updates.
Delays flagged the day they start, not the year they're discovered.
Progress and spending, open for anyone to check.
That's the coordination Omnix is building for.
A.L.K.I. to plan and foresee. OmniChain to keep a record no one can quietly edit.
No one builds a metro alone.
It takes engineers, workers, planners, citizens, and the people who run our cities, working from the same truth.
Planets don't collide, because each one moves in step with the others.
Let's make the next promise one we can all watch being kept.
